title: Grid columns share the width evenly and cannot be resized
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses, so the grid has at least three tier columns.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1512 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Try to drag the border between tier A's and tier B's headers.
  4. Click Edit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Default and every tier column are the same width as each other.
  • At least Default and three tier columns show without scrolling sideways.

Step 3:

  • The grid still shows every column at the same width.
  • The border cannot be dragged to resize a column.

Step 4:

  • In edit, Default and the tier columns are still the same width as each other.
  • The simulator's Default and tier columns are the same width as each other too.
